name: Followed
notes: Dark roasted coffee with a hefty pour of sweetener and a sprinkling of cinnamon and clove spices. Rugged yet comforting. Like heading out of a warm home on a bitterly cold winter morning.

name: Sweetly Known
style: This is a cardamom-forward gourmand with a hint of retro cola... Perfect for anyone who favors a richly spiced and unique gourmand scent.

name: Winter of 99
style: This fragrance is very spice forward. Hints of nutmeg
clove and molasses emerge in the dry down and call to mind sipping chai tea under a blanket.

name: Walk the Sea
style: Not your typical salty ocean or sunscreen scent
and transportive. Briny ambergris mingles with white florals and musk to form a seaside scent with no hard edges -- this fragrance is an ocean of enveloping softness.

name: Summer of 84
style: is followed by mellower notes of melon and musk. This is a fresh and nostalgic scent that's easy to love.

name: Follow
notes: dark coffee with a generous pour of sweetener and a sprinkling of clove and cinnamon. Rugged yet comforting - the smell of a sleepy winter morning.

name: Blackmail
style: This is a unisex smoky fragrance that verges on gourmand -- oud and smoke curl around berries and vanilla to create a mysterious sillage that doesn't grow cloying.

name: Broken Theories
style: Dry woods with smoky leather and a subtly rubbery
like the woodshop in your grandfather's garage.

name: Dirty Flower Factory
style: decaying white florals fade into a bright

name: Black Vines
style: Anise is absolutely the star of the show here -- for lovers of black licorice ONLY.

name: Pretty Machine
style: Bright and airy florals on a clean and powdery base. Shower-fresh and wonderfully nostalgic.

name: Unknown Pleasures
style: A citrusy gourmand with a *hint* of a garage note -- motor oil and gasoline peek out from behind honey and vanilla.

name: Santalum Slivers
style: Santalum Slivers is much more than your average sandalwood. Watery cucumber and peppery rose are both detectable as part of a fresh and harmonious woody accord.

name: Copper Skies
style: An initial blast of sharp metal dries into a wonderfully warm
smoked spice fragrance. Like a cozy

name: R'oud Elements
style: A fizzy and refreshing herbal citrus. Bright with smoothed edges.

name: M.D.
style: M.D. has got to be both one of the sexiest and most comforting wood scents out there- fiery black pepper
and soft musk provide an equal measure of blissful relaxation. Together
they make a unique and dynamic wood fragrance not to be missed.

name: L.B.
style: A sparkling fresh blend of bright citrus
paper-like iris on a soft bed of ambrox musk and cashmere woods- a pretty and timeless floral with a modern musky drydown.

name: A.N.
style: ambery woods to create possibly the most intense scent in the D'Orsay line.

name: C.G.
style: What does a fragrance with over a century of history smell like? In the case of C.G.
like it sprung from a garden yesterday- it's a gorgeously enchanting melange of full
romantic green floral freshness that never tips into sour or bitter territory thanks to a gentle touch of beeswax. A must-try for green fragrance lovers.

name: J.R.
notes: J.R. isn't one of D'Orsay's loudest scents
but for those who prefer subtle beauty
citrus-kissed watery floral with pretty and unique violet
and narcissus notes will more than reward those lucky enough to be invited close.

name: M.A.
style: A smoothly sparkling aldehyde iris that dries to a still fresh
yet sensual bed of synthetic musks
M.A. is about as modern an ode to love as exists- but its sexiness is beyond doubt. It smells very different on everyone's skin
so be sure to try it for yourself!

name: E.Q.
style: A skin scent for people who still want to be noticed
creamy iris and a cashmere-amber musk that leaves a warm

name: G.A.
style: carefree leather scent? Why not? G.A. pulls it off with charm to spare. While it's still unmistakably leather

it's made bright and cheerful thanks to perfect balance- juicy grapefruit and smooth black tea keeping fiery cardamom and rich leather from ever feeling heavy or stuffy. A leather scent that can get compliments on a hot summer day- now we've heard it all.

name: Lilac
notes: fresh feminine floral that perfectly replicates the gorgeous aroma of the fleeting annual blossoming of this intoxicating flower. Effervescent top notes of sparkling bergamot and leafy green accord unfold into a romantic heart of living floral lilac and muguet. A dusting of suede is enhanced by the sensual warmth of amber at the dry-down.

name: Honeysuckle
notes: Honeysuckle is a true fresh feminine floral
framed by uplifting top notes of juicy mandarin and neroli. Living floral Honeysuckle and orange flower form a lush bouquet at the heart
leading to a serenely beautiful dry-down of velvet moss and sheer musk.

name: Rose
notes: wearable rose— never too heady or cloying; just so well-rounded

name: Almond
notes: sweet and intoxicating– it's easy to see why this has a devoted cult following. An irresistible gourmand fragrance that's a must-own for any gourmand lover...

name: Peony
notes: Peony is sheer pink bliss: a beautifully sweet peek-a-boo between juicy wild berries and pink peonies

name: Orchid
notes: Orchid is a velvety sweet drama. At center stage
living floral Cattleya Orchid shines with fresh-cut freesia
and crystallized vanilla adding a delicious gourmand nuance to the finish.

name: Slow World
style: A fragrance inspired by Chinese fermented black tea

Pu'er tea. Dried fruits and honey accentuate the fruity notes in dragon's blood resin to create a sweet and resinous amber fragrance. Incense provides smoky undertones which recreate the traditional tea ceremony. Beautiful and meditative.

name: Tea Service
style: Fruity goji berries and juicy white peach mingle with jasmine to create that perfect subtly-sweet oolang tea fragrance that we've been searching for!

name: Weeping Rose
style: A cold and dewy morning fills the air with the smell of fresh fig leaves and earth. Buds of roses begin to slowly bloom creating a beautiful fresh and peppery rose. Just so lovely!

name: Rain Tea
notes: Fragrant chamomile and chrysanthemum mix with earthy hay to recreate the scent of dried tea leaves. Fruity longan berries and honey to help create a cozy and comforting tea scent.

name: Lost In Paradise
style: Bright and sparkling; a summery essence that plays well to both your playful and serious side.

name: Drunk Lovers
style: While we're a fan of BTSO's existing booze fragrances Sex & Cognac and Drunk Saffron
they're both so richly warm and mouthwateringly gourmand that you might find yourself craving something a bit more agile. Don't get us wrong

and resinous woods make sure of that- but it's kept energetic and sexy with a dynamic combination of vibrant citrus with invigorating spices and aromatics that lift up the heavier booze and gourmand notes. As the brand suggests
this is a scent for those with a reason to stay up all night long.

name: Indecent Cherry
style: Incandescent Cherry might be an even better name for this impossibly bright
full-bodied cherry scent that tempers its sugary sweetness with a perfect balance of tart and sour fruit notes and a smoothly musky amber base. An absolute must try for cherry fragrance fans!

name: Fig Porn
notes: There's something uniquely carnal about fig scents- the fertility of the green freshness combined with the overwhelming
and sexy. As the name would imply
Fig Porn captures all of that outrageous carnality
tempering it with just enough lush
romantic florals in the heart and gourmand musk in the base to make this safe to wear in public- if only just.

name: Smokin' Gun
notes: We love a good campfire scent as much as the next smoke lover
but sometimes you're looking for something different. Smokin' Gun is more cocktail lounge than campsite
and the unique combination of bitter and boozy liquors
and polished woods makes for a very different kind of smokiness indeed- a night that stretches into the wee hours at one of the world's most exclusive speakeasies.

name: Drunk Saffron
notes: yet chic exploration of one of the most precious spices on earth. Rich
sweet cognac and syrupy plum meld with creamy vanilla to complement the gourmand side of the balance
while a robustly musky leather lends a sophisticated touch of unisex modern elegance.

name: Dirty Rice
style: If you love the indulgently creamy side of sandalwood
this beguiling fragrance delivers a rich and stylish blend of santal
with enough woodsy presence to balance the gourmand with a sexy modern kick.

name: Vanilla in Bourbon
style: non-dessert vanillas like Vanille Havane and Eau Duelle should find a perfect match in this seductively deep but not-too-sweet unisex vanilla and its warm

name: Sandalwood in Oak
notes: The unique textures and provocative nuances of this intoxicating fragrance are bound to leave a profound impression. With an intensity that waxes and wanes throughout the day
this is a fragrance that imprints itself on the senses. Indulge in this sophisticated blend

name: Praline in Maple
notes: and smoked syrup. This fragrance exudes the addiction of maple syrup and intrigue of mysterious woods. Cedarwood Atlas has an earthy
woody leathery aroma with hints of balsamic sweetness while Peru Balsam is laced with notes of vanilla
and even a trace of white floral intoxication.

name: Cedar in Acacia
notes: Feel the warmth of a sun-kissed embrace with a fragrance that embarks you on a journey of spices
and amber to create an enthralling exhilaration of the senses.

name: Resonant
notes: zesty energy.. does this resonate with you? It does for us...

name: Dead Air
notes: burnt sugar... it's all there in Dead Air.

name: Trouble in Paradise
style: We've fallen in love with more than a few tropical boozy fragrances lately
but Trouble In Paradise is just a bit different from the rest. While it does open with a mouthwatering
the booziness has a decidedly sultry twist
spiced cognac and a touch of animalic growl in the leather and woods base. It's less "poolside colada" and more "sunset cocktail
" and we couldn't be more into it.

name: Escapade Gourmande
style: A winner— Escapade Gourmande is the vanilla fragrance we've be craving. Swirls of vanilla meet cubes of black sugar and dark
warm tonka bean for a mouthwatering treat (think ice cream/gelato)– we just can't get enough of this gem!

name: Bonbons a la Vanille
style: A tahitian vanilla bean ganache with a perfectly slightly burnt caramel center recreates the sweet and indulgent scent of a vanilla bonbon. Peru balsam adds richness and warmth
creating a fragrance that lingers on the skin for hours on end like the taste of a decadent dessert. For lovers of Tihota

name: Oui Plus!
notes: Styrax And A Bit Of Burnt Coffee.

name: Lucienne
style: Bright pomelo and lemon zest shine
never becoming bitter or sharp. Aldehydic notes in magnolia and water lily are brought forward

creating a gently powdery and soapy scent reminiscent of clean linens wafting in the breeze. Marine accords highlight the aquatic notes in water lilies to recreate the smell of a refreshing riverbed. A fragrance truly as delicate and light as a springtime morning!

name: Rose Struck
style: juicy tangerine and cassis pair perfectly against a backdrop of two kinds of fresh rose petals. Watery and slightly green matcha tea mellows the mixture
creating an ultra wearable and completely unique fragrance experience.

name: Studied
style: Like whispers echoing amongst a cavernous stack of worn books
and fleeting. Pear and carrot seed
fade quietly into an understated skin scent
made of ambroxan and cashmere.  A beautiful
perfect for a cozy day in (at your local library

name: Floating
style: Floating is the freeing feeling of a day of leisure
effortless and dreamy.  Snuggled in fresh sheets
the scent of ripening peaches drifts in from the kitchen
along with a woody breeze from an open window nearby
scattering shadows across the room. Light
Floating has us in a wistful daze.

name: Bo
style: In the heart of an imaginary forest of redwood pine
toasted vanilla beans are layered together with rich
smoky tobacco leaves to create a surprisingly indulgent woody blend. With impressive silage and longevity
Bo is the award-winning bestseller from the Liis line

name: Maggie the Cat is Alive! I’m Alive!
Petrichor
notes: one of the more polarizing notes in fragrance
is made into it's most likeable self with a bright touch of immortelle laced with lemon juice. However
perfumer Marissa Zappas clearly hasn't forgotten the root of the fragrance
as the finish digs deep into the earth fresh after rain
with touches of sandalwood and moss.

name: Violette Hay
style: nutty carrot seed and apricot combine for an enchanting yet comforting wear
saffron and suede.  Like peering into a fairy garden
Violette Hay will have you in an otherworldly trance.

name: Flaming Creature
notes: Flaming Creature reminds us of Icarus
flying too close to a sunny note of juniper and orange (Ring Pop)
all to get smoked out and tumble down into absurd bushels of night-blooming jasmine soaked in rum.  As mysterious as it is confounding

name: Annabel's Birthday Cake
style: Annabel's Birthday Cake is a scrumptious take on a floral dessert fragrance.  However
this scent isn't loud or overly sweet

rather creamy and nuanced. Powdery heliotrope and delicate lemon sugar couple with a sprinkling of candied rose petals and a layer of tuberose frosting to balance any candy-like qualities with supple florals
making this cake one to be enjoyed any day.

name: Lazy Sunday Morning
style: Like stepping out of the shower and falling into soft
this sparkling clean linen musk will positively surround you in fresh

name: By The Fireplace
style: An instant classic since it's initial release in 2015
By The Fireplace is the perfect balance of sweet & smokey in a scent.  Woody and creamy chestnut adds a smoothness to guaiac wood and spicy clove
while vanilla gives a delicious finish.

name: Jazz Club
style: and boozy with just the right amount of smoky tobacco
this perfect-for-cool-evenings treat is considered a standout from the Replica line for very good reason.

name: Mangonifiscent
style: Mango gets the Unique'e Luxury touch of gourmand elegance with this deliciously fresh and authentic mango
nestled among lush notes of jasmine and rose
syrupy honey. A sensually musky amber base makes this a perfect choice for those who love fruity scents like Erba Pura and Instant Crush.

name: Vanille Riviera
notes: A chiaroscuro built around a green vanilla
in which the dark sensuality of the pod
embraces the bright voluptuousness of white flowers. A reference example of what a sophisticated gourmand can be.

name: Panettone
style: Panettone is a delight.  An effervescent cocktail of ginger and orange meet rum and nutty
creating a kaleidoscope of flavor.  The drydown leaves us with the sweetness of a celebratory fruit-soaked cake during a well-deserved holiday.

name: Basilica
style: Basilica is equal parts comforting and elegant.  Incense and cedar bring an earthy warmth to the base
making it the perfect choice for a cozy night in.

name: Naviglio
style: A chic unisex soap fragrance.  A scent that never goes too powdery or detergent-like
this is a vacation to the Italian Riviera in a bottle that stays smooth and sophisticated the entire wear time.

name: AEOM
notes: Rarely is a fragrance so appropriately named- you really can't help but sit up and notice this dynamic and
woodsy florals. But AEOM's niftiest trick of all is how it combines these potentially overwhelming elements into a cohesive
surprisingly bright and wearable unisex fragrance that works on anyone

name: Murice Imperiale
style: mineral tuberose; unlike anything we've tried before. Highly recommended.

name: Red Wine Brown Sugar
notes: Spicy and fruity with only a hint of sweetness
this red wine scent ignites the senses and makes the mouth water.

name: Coffee White Flowers
notes: this is an enchanting dark liqueur to warm the bones and soothe the soul.

name: Sea Salt Caramel
notes: this is the distant scent of boardwalk confections carried on a salty ocean wind.

name: Vanilla Black Pepper
notes: For vanilla lovers who aren't looking for a sugary dessert
this spicy and sensual potion is an enchantingly versatile offering.

name: Narcisse Taiji
notes: The gentle power of narcissus shines in this fresh and lovely floral with delicate spice and fruit accents.

name: Cacao Porcelana
notes: Boozy rum and rich cacao- a beguiling cocktail that feels both lusciously mouthwatering and refreshing at the same time.

name: Al Ghaliya Bulgare Fleuri Et Animalique
Cacao in the Sun
style: Radiant with lemon and sun-drenched orange blossom
this is a chocolate fragrance for lovers of gourmands and florals alike.  Lily
while a combination of vanilla and sandalwood give us a sunscreen-like impression
transportive to a dream-like beachside tropical paradise.

name: Vicious Cacao
style: It isn't often that the note of chocolate in fragrance is made into a spicy
it truly is.  Bright and tangy raspberry immediately collides with rose pepper
jasmine and narcissus to form a jammy botanic opening.  Mellow saffron and sweetened salty caramel and cocoa absolute mix at the heart for a spiced treat any gourmand fan will love
which gives way to boozy rum
warm resinous amber and earthy oak moss upon dry down.  Utterly stupefying
Vicious Cacao will leave your head spinning and your heart craving more.

name: Carnal Cacao
style: Carnal Cacao is unlike anything we've experienced in the gourmand world before.  Created by Paul Guerlain
a hot note of red pepper mingles with luminous neroli essential oil and bubbling mandarin. Tuberose is then married to this radiant combination
creating an indolic and intoxicating floral blend that will captivate and seduce.  The drydown exposes a base of cocoa absolute and ambroxan that provide a lasting
toasted chocolate base which will have you longing for another spray--we certainly were!

name: Cacao2
style: Refined with a dash of warm & dry cinnamon
complemented by toasted notes and rich vanilla
we think we've found the coziest gourmand fragrance yet!  Cocoa is wrapped in a dark coat of benzoin
and amber while spicy notes linger above. A chocolate fragrance made for chocolate lovers

name: Sticky Fingers
style: leathery iris. What's not to love?

name: Tyger Tyger
style: Sweet honeyed florals with a woodsy edge
this one is both date-night sexy and everyday wearable.

name: Etruscan Water
style: old-school chypre with loads of citrus and ambergris
this fragrance has a special blend of vintage power and unique charm.

name: Under My Skin
style: Some fragrances just have an indescribable compulsion to them- a mystery that keeps you coming back to them again and again. Under My Skin's creamy
animalic iris leather has just the right touch of mystery.

name: The Dark Side
style: The Dark Side balances exoticism with elegant restraint.

name: Sex and the Sea
style: this is a beachy skin scent with a dangerous edge.

name: Hermit Coat
style: Evocative of pilgrimages and sacred halls
Hermit Coat is a spiritual fragrance experience.  Notes of balm
and olibanum combine to create a powdery yet resinous
waxy and smokey adventure into forgotten hours of a lost time where solitary travelers sought refuge in holy chambers.

name: Black Citrus
style: invigorating citrus with an intriguingly modern profile from the mate and violet heart.

name: Mango Skin
style: Luscious and mouthwatering with a small but lively touch of spice- perfect for lovers of full bodied fruit scents.

name: Morning Chess
style: and a touch wild- a leather with a comfortably natural streak.

name: Poets of Berlin
style: with just the right amount of discord
this scent certainly captures the "beautiful chaos" of bohemian creativity.

name: Basilico & Fellini
style: An invigorating basil note is the star attraction here
but a mouthwatering fig note deserves equal credit in this fresh and fun everyday perfect scent.

name: The Last PH 85
style: "What does it truly mean to be pure of heart?"

That is the question we were asking ourselves before smelling The Last PH (Pure Heart) 85.
By all assumptions
we expected to be introduced to a happy-go-lucky
encompassing innocence with a carefree attitude.  Suffice to say

we were surprised and entranced at the resulting experience.
A blast of black currant & blood orange fruity sweetness meets balsamic
much like childhood joys meeting the inevitable responsibilities of life.  The fragrance then descends into a smoky & woody tobacco
as imminent as the unavoidable deeper real-world issues one has to encounter.  However
facets of amber and vanilla reveal themselves

warm and caring amongst the other darker features.
This scent has reminded us that although one may be surrounded by troubles and trials in life
what matters is seeing the warmth
and light in yourself and others.  That is what it truly means to be pure of heart.

name: Black Beard
notes: Led by an intense lavender-and-herbs heart that's both fiercely masculine and also intriguingly mouthwatering
backed with a rich & earthy tobacco base
rich scent for those who dare to stand out.

name: Gris Charnel Extrait
notes: Cedar Essence From The United States
style: this is Gris Charnel with the volume turned way up. This time
the cult-favorite original scent has a fig note that plays in the background
and tonka take center stage. Perfect for a sophisticated outing or an intimate night in
Gris Charnel Extrait is the scent to make a statement.

name: Mercurial Cashmere
notes: and caramel radiate a powerful warmth which at once captures and invites those around to lean in closer.  A bouquet of violet
and tuberose award a sweet and powdery quality
while bright pink pepper and cardamom top off the experience with crisp spice.

name: Amber Aquilaria
style: Bold and rich but with a vibrant twinkle
this extravagant spiced amber has a surprising touch of energy.

name: Trajan
style: ambered woods come together in a dynamic unisex scent.

name: Loudo
style: Spirited (yet anything but childish) the new release from Sarah Baker has us beguiled with it's challenging mix of oud
and black cherry.  This is not a gourmand for the faint of heart
as the animalic edge will invite our normal oud-wearers to get their sweet tooth fix.

name: Anatolia Anatolia
notes: The bestselling Anatolia that all fans of PRIN will know has received a fresh upgrade with added base notes.  Less emphasis on the fruity top notes of apple and dates lead to a firmer
more grounded leather scent.  Added natural oud is distinct and noticeable
almost damp floor.  Resting on top is still the unmistakably mouth-watering honey and powdery loukhoum that anyone with a sweet tooth will adore.

name: Mriga
notes: Peat *this Fragrance Contains No Animal Products

name: Mandodari
notes: Teak. *Does Not Contain Any Actual Animal Products

name: Athenaeum
notes: full-bodied spicy floral with a rich balsamic leather base
Athenaeum makes a compelling unisex statement.

name: Fantosmia
notes: with a subtly animalic tobacco base
Fantosmia is a complex and compelling unisex experience.

name: Chetyre
notes: Chetyre hits you with the full intensity of Russian leather
and then methodically reveals an aromatic and floral sophistication hidden beneath. A must-try for lovers of smoky leather.

name: Sweet Farewell
style: A not-overly-sweet foodie gourmand... Creamy and nutty

name: Caffeine Honey
style: if you already crave Prin Lomros' other scents in this style (Roasted Coffee
you are almost guaranteed to be struck by Caffeine Honey.  Lomros has chosen to indulge even more by turning the honey and coffee notes way up
cuddly treat if we ever did find one
Caffeine Honey is sure to lift your spirits and indulge your sweet tooth.

name: Bisquit
style: Dive into the latest gourmand confection from Arte Profumi like a child at an ice cream shoppe.  Swirls of coffee and chocolate surround a creamy vanilla heart like a fantastic drizzle on an indulgent ice cream sundae.  A sprinkling of bitter orange zest on top and a cocoa powder drydown make this dessert completely irresistible.

name: Patchouli Noisette
notes: Patchouli Grand Cru From Indonesia & Sri Lanka

name: Ambre Supreme
notes: Clary Sage Oil Switzerland Grand Cru
Immortelle Extract From France Grand Cru (From the Brand's Private Field)
style: Ambre Supreme opens with a blast of spice
cinnamon and pink peppercorn accenting its radiant heart of jasmine and orange flower. As it settles on skin
it mellows into a drydown as delicate and diaphanous as gossamer
as if the notes were now experienced behind a panel of sheer silk
with flashes of clary sage like the woven leaves on a garland. But Ambre Supreme is not all lightness. Ambergris can reveal the darkness of a composition’s facets as well as its brightness
and Ambre Supreme morphs occasionally in something animalic
and Hyraceum casting a shadowy sensuality into Ambre Supreme’s otherwise bright corners. Delicate yet sensual
Ambre Supreme has a fresh yet haunting beauty like its crown jewel ingredient: the paradoxical Ambergris

name: Chypre Azural
notes: Egyptian Centifolia Rose Absolute Grand Cru

name: B683
style: An oh-so-wearable leather scent that feels smoothly sophisticated but dynamically modern- the spice and woods add tone and energy without sacrificing elegance.

name: Ganymede
style: more floral interpretation of the ultra-smooth top grain leather also featured in B683- airy but still substantial.

name: No. 7 Le Sel de la Terre
Water Therapy
notes: WATER THERAPY is inspired by the concept of blue medicine
the belief that water positively impacts our mental health with its relaxing
stress-relieving benefits. This “functional fragrance” uses olfactory technology to replicate the sensory feeling of being in or around water
formulated with a marine-inspired blend of calming notes.

name: Forest Lungs
notes: A unisex anti-stress fragrance supplement that delivers the healing effects of nature to the body. The sense of wellbeing you experience when you are in nature isn’t just a feeling
it’s science. Forest Lungs is citrusy
with a somewhat incense vibe to it... really enjoyable-- we can see why this has sold out numerous times.

name: Oud Caravan No. 3
notes: Natural Aged Wild Bengali Oud Oil

name: Usubeni (Rosy Cheeks)
notes: A youthfully fruity feminine floral with fresh green vibes
Usubeni feels like a fragrance for any age from 4 to 104.

name: Black Leather
notes: musky leather that feels both sexy and refined
this is probably the edgiest scent in the lineup while still perfectly appropriate for everyday wear.

name: Shaft of Light
style: fresh scent a perfect ray of sunshine for everyday wear.

name: Honey & Lemon
style: An everyday combination presented with distinction- the lemon is bright
and balsamic. If you love citrus but are looking for something more relaxing than energizing
Honey & Lemon is a perfect choice.

name: Hisui (Jade)
style: but a smooth floral heart smooths the rough edges for a luminous sophistication.

name: Yawahada (Soft Skin)
style: yet powerful aura of clean sexiness. It's your skin

name: Yuzu
style: impressively long-lasting citrus scent is the perfect balance of sweet and tart with a sophisticated twist of thyme.

name: Sumo Wrestler
style: and lightly powdery wood notes gives this dynamic scent the feel of a barbershop masculine through an eastern lens.

name: Hydrangea
style: A full-bodied yet fresh and cool jasmine-forward white floral- lush and naturalistic.

name: Rakugan (Sugar Sweets)
style: distinctively balsamic sugariness of this scent is a guaranteed mood improver with enough complexity to be surprisingly sensual on the right person.

name: Hanamizake (Cherry Blossom Sake)
style: Inspired by the Japanese tradition of festive dining and drinking under the blooming cherry trees
this delightful scent combines gentle notes of fruity booze with smooth
fresh cherry blossom to keep you smelling fresh all day long.

name: Roasted Green Tea
style: nutty aroma of real roasted tea. A unique and delectable fragrance for tea lovers.

name: Neva Winged Lions
style: If you long to be transported to a summertime tea party in a garden in full bloom
we may have found your holy grail.  Gorgeous blooms of peony and freesia are married with languid and effervescent jasmine tea.  All are wrapped in bushels of cotton flower and violet
leading to a pillowy soft drydown perfect for an afternoon nap under the trees.

name: Scheherazade
notes: While many people rightfully love Bortnikoff for their most opulent oud-centric elixirs
we honestly have a soft spot for the fragrances that breathe new life into a familiar genre by way of their best-in-world ingredients and exquisite small-batch craftsmanship. In Scheherazade
Bortnikoff and Mr. Balkrishnan gift us with a gourmand that makes the mouth water and the pulse race at the same time
a surprisingly limber and seductive concoction that balances indulgent fruits and (unlisted but very present) smooth
all brought together with an energetic
spice-forward wild oud that wears with a notably modern flair. If you love the gourmand-but-sexy vibes of Parfums de Marly Layton or Nishane Ani
you won't want to miss this stunning release.

name: Santa Sangre
notes: A scent that takes you on a spiritual journey and only comes around once in awhile.  Soft
with beautiful nuances;  A perfume with true originality. Santa Sangre is definitely a fine example of what niche perfumery is all about.

name: Tabac Dore
notes: Wild Oud From Thailand And Vietnam

name: Musk Therapy
style: Silky smooth musk and the perfect touch of mouthwatering
juicy orange and blackcurrant- what's not to love?

name: Ingenious Ginger
notes: get ready for something special- Ingenious Ginger's uniquely luscious interpretation of Australian Ginger Flower means that this is different from any other ginger scent out there. Yes
the fiery power of raw ginger root still delivers its invigorating kick
but it's paired with a blend of sparkling citrus
glowing amber to create a ginger fragrance of distinct sensuality and fullness that stands out from the crowd.

name: Purple Suede
style: Purple Suede opens with a violet flash of Tasmanian Lavender – rich in its complex sweetness and clean
aromatic freshness. The richness of amber settles atop Woodleather– a smoky
sensuous accord of deeply-patina saddle leather and dark woods. A perfume of precious woods
luxurious leather– Purple Suede is a sophisticated lavender with an ode to pristine quality.

name: Silky Woods
notes: and spicy- blends with rich saffron and gently smoky tobacco to produce an utterly luxurious agarwood scent with enough complexity to appeal to oud lovers but enough silky smoothness to win over even those who don't generally go for oud.

name: No.09 Vallee de Farney - Eau de Parfum
No.04 Bois de Balincourt - Eau de Parfum
Keman
notes: Keman opens with notes of Japanese rose
